remarks: A little Venice history. A whole lot of beachside possibility. Just steps from the sand, on one of Venice's coveted walk streets, sits a home that is anything but ordinary. Welcome to 10 30th Avenue, a soulful coastal retreat where the timeless charm of old Venice meets the fresh, vibrant energy of modern beach living. Rather than erase its history, this thoughtful reimagination celebrates it. Original architectural details have been lovingly preserved, rediscovered, and brought back to life, creating a beautiful dialogue between yesterday and today.
